content: It’s not even October yet and Amazon is already offering some Prime Big Deal Day discounts on its own hardware, along with plenty of other popular products. It’s all to hype up October Prime Day, which starts October 6th at 3AM ET and lasts through 3AM ET on the 8th if you’re on the East Coast (12AM PT). October Prime Day offers a glimpse of deals that will likely be available again during Black Friday and Cyber Monday. So, with the holiday shopping season officially underway, you can get some of your shopping out of the way before things get busier as we approach the holidays. The most recent update to this post on October 4th was a big one. There are several deals from Apple and Beats, plus Kindle-related ones from Amazon, to name a few. Previously, we added a couple of Bose speakers and Belkin charging products. This post will be updated ahead of October 6th as new deals become available. chineseContent: 还没到十月，亚马逊就已经在自己的硬件上提供了一些 Prime Big Deal Day 折扣，以及许多其他受欢迎的产品。这一切都是为了炒作 10 月黄金日，如果您在东海岸（太平洋时间中午 12 点），该日将于 10 月 6 日东部时间凌晨 3 点开始，一直持续到 8 日凌晨 3 点。十月黄金日让您可以一睹黑色星期五和网络星期一期间可能再次提供的优惠。因此，随着假日购物季的正式开始，您可以在假期临近之前购物变得更加繁忙。 10 月 4 日这篇文章的最新更新是一次重大更新。 Apple 和 Beats 提供了多项优惠，亚马逊也提供了与 Kindle 相关的优惠，仅举几例。之前，我们添加了一些 Bose 扬声器和 Belkin 充电产品。随着新优惠的推出，这篇文章将在 10 月 6 日之前更新。 [产品：贝尔金充电盒 Pro | https://www.amazon.com/Belkin-Nintendo-Switch-Charging-10000mAh/dp/B0GN8HWT7N?th=1&tag=theverge02-20， https://belkin.evyy.net/c/482924/214281/3736?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.belkin.com%2Fp%2Fcharging-case-pro%2FENA003fqSA.html] [产品：Nex Playground | https://www.amazon.com/Playground-AI-Powered-Transforms-Not-Machine-Specific/dp/B0D2JGYX3F?tag=theverge02-20， https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FNex-Playground-Game-System%2F9402952208， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fplayground-the-active-play-system-for-kids-families-indoor-physical-play-meets-interactive-family-fun%2FJ3Q5RY2VVT] [产品：Kindle Scribe Colorsoft | https://www.amazon.com/Amazon-Kindle-Scribe-Colorsoft/dp/B0DWRBVDN6/?tag=theverge02-20，https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10
